title: 第009章 血魔陨落第010章 系统反吞噬
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家

华纪55年9月5日，傍晚，北极冰原。
两百四十枚灵能导弹的饱和攻击将血魔的肉身彻底摧毁，但化神巅峰的上古邪修不可能这么容易死透。就在血色晶核被张德华一枪打碎的瞬间，一道极其微弱的血光从晶核碎片中逸出，以不可思议的速度向天际遁去。
那是血魔的元神。肉身可以毁，晶核可以碎，但只要元神不灭，他就能夺舍重生。这是血魔最后的保命底牌——将一缕本命元神藏在晶核最深处，连天道仙尊的封印都没能磨灭。一万年的等待，他等的就是这一刻。
“哈哈哈哈！”血魔元神的狂笑在虚空中回荡，“小辈！你毁我肉身，碎我晶核，但想杀我？做梦！本座元神不灭，百年之后又是一条好汉！”
血光划破长空，向天罡星域深处逃窜。血魔的元神速度极快，眨眼间就飞出了数十里。以他的经验，只要逃出这片星域，随便找个凡人夺舍，闭关百年就能恢复修为。到那时，他一定要回来报仇，将华夏联盟的人全部炼成血食。
但张德华没有追。
他只是站在原地，抬起右手，食指和中指并拢，对准那道远去的血光。手指上，一枚银色的空间戒指正在发光——那枚戒指里，安装着一台微型空间跳跃装置。
“定。”
空间戒指释放出一道透明的波纹，以超越光速的速度扩散开去。波纹追上血光的那一瞬间，周围的空间被冻结了。不是时间的停止，而是空间的锁定——血魔元神所在的区域被从主空间中“切”了出来，形成一个封闭的子空间。
血魔的元神在子空间中疯狂撞击，但每一下都撞在空间壁上，根本出不去。
“这……这是什么？！”血魔的声音里第一次充满了真正的恐惧。他活了一万多年，见过无数法宝，但从未见过能锁定空间的东西。
张德华一步跨出，身形出现在子空间前。他从空间戒指中取出一枚透明的晶体容器——那是特制的灵能囚笼，专门用来关押修士元神。他把容器口对准子空间，轻声道：“收。”
子空间连同里面的血魔元神一起，被吸入了晶体容器中。容器的盖子自动合上，表面的封印符文亮起，将血魔元神牢牢锁在里面。
张德华把容器举到眼前，看着里面那团疯狂挣扎的血光。
“饶命！饶命啊！”血魔的声音从容器中传出，充满了乞求，“我愿意做牛做马！我愿意献上我的全部功法！我愿意成为你的奴仆！只要你饶我一命！”
“做牛做马？”张德华平静地看着他，“你作恶万年，吞噬了多少无辜者的血肉？刚才你破封而出，第一件事就是要屠尽天下。现在知道怕了？”
“我……我改！我真的改！求求你，给我一次机会！”
“机会？”张德华摇了摇头，“那些被你吞噬的人，你有没有给过他们机会？”
血魔沉默了。

“一万年前，天道仙尊用毕生修为将你镇压，已经是给了你机会。一万年的时间，你没有悔改，反而怨气更重。这样的人，不配再活。”
张德华握紧容器，五指用力。
“不——！”
容器破碎的瞬间，张德华的掌心释放出一股精纯的法力，将血魔的元神包裹其中。法力如磨盘般碾压，将血魔的元神一寸寸碾碎。血光在掌心中疯狂挣扎，发出凄厉的惨叫，但无济于事。
三息之后，惨叫声停止。
血魔的元神化作点点红光，消散在暮色中。这一次，是真正的形神俱灭，连转世投胎的机会都没有了。
“系统。”张德华轻声说。
“在。检测到宿主击杀化神巅峰邪修血魔。评价：越阶击杀，奖励修为。”
一股精纯的能量从系统中涌出，灌入张德华的体内。丹田中的元婴猛地睁开双眼，贪婪地吸收着这股能量。元婴的身高从七寸五分增长到了七寸八分，气息也变得更加凝实。
“奖励计算完毕。宿主修为提升：元婴六重，进度百分之三十。”
“百分之三十？”张德华微微点头，“杀一个化神巅峰，顶我修炼三个月。不错。”
他收回手，转身走向仙府入口。身后，北极冰原的暮色中，导弹炸出的巨坑还在冒着青烟。一代邪魔，从破封到陨落，不过半个时辰。
仙府入口处，探险队的成员们还在等待。玄霜看着张德华手中消散的红光，眼中满是复杂。一万年前，天道仙尊牺牲自己才镇压的邪魔，被眼前这个年轻人用不到一个小时就彻底消灭了。
“首长，血魔……死了？”周明教授小心翼翼地问。
“形神俱灭。”张德华说，“收队。”
他大步走出仙府，登上等候多时的凌霄战机。引擎轰鸣，战机冲天而起，消失在暮色中。
北极冰原恢复了宁静。只剩下那个巨大的弹坑，和空气中残留的焦糊味，证明这里曾经发生过一场不对等的战斗。
华夏基地，指挥中心。
张德华回到基地时，已经是晚上八点。他没有休息，直接走进作战会议室。
“血魔的事告一段落。”他坐在主位上，打开全息屏幕，“但仙府最底层的封印松动，说明那里镇压的不止血魔一个。我们需要加快对仙府的探索速度，在更多邪物破封之前，把它们全部消灭。”

“是！”所有人齐声应道。
“另外。”张德华看向资源管理部门，“仙府里的灵石矿脉样本分析得怎么样了？”
“已经完成初步分析。”资源部长汇报，“仙府灵石矿脉的纯度是普通灵石的十倍，而且结构更稳定，适合人工合成。”
“人工合成？”张德华的眼睛亮了，“能量产吗？”
“理论上可以。我们需要建一座灵石合成工厂。”

On September 5, 55 AD, in the evening, the Arctic ice field.
The saturation attack of two hundred and forty psychic missiles completely destroyed the blood demon's body, but the ancient evil cultivator at the peak of becoming a god could not die so easily. At the moment when the blood-colored crystal core was shattered by Zhang Dehua's shot, an extremely weak bloody light escaped from the fragments of the crystal core and escaped towards the sky at an incredible speed.
That is the soul of the blood demon. The physical body can be destroyed and the crystal core can be broken, but as long as the soul is immortal, he can be reborn. This is the blood demon's last life-saving trump card - hiding a ray of his own soul in the deepest part of the crystal core, even the seal of the Tiandao Immortal Lord cannot be erased. After ten thousand years of waiting, he had been waiting for this moment.
"Hahahaha!" The crazy laughter of the Blood Demon Soul echoed in the void, "Junior! You destroyed my body and shattered my crystal core, but you want to kill me? Dreaming! My soul will never be destroyed, and I will be a good man again in a hundred years!"
The bloody light cut through the sky and fled deep into the Tiangang Star Territory. The blood demon's soul is extremely fast and can fly dozens of miles in the blink of an eye. Based on his experience, as long as he escapes from this star field, he can find a mortal to take over his body, and he can recover in seclusion for a hundred years. By then, he must come back to take revenge and turn all the people of the Chinese Alliance into blood food.
But Zhang Dehua did not pursue him.
He just stood there, raised his right hand, put his index and middle fingers together, and aimed at the receding bloody light. On his finger, a silver space ring was glowing - a miniature space jumping device was installed in that ring.
"Sure."
The space ring releases a transparent ripple that spreads out at a speed exceeding the speed of light. The moment the ripples caught up with the blood, the surrounding space was frozen. It's not the stopping of time, but the locking of space - the area where the Blood Demon Yuanshen is located is "cut" out of the main space, forming a closed subspace.
The blood demon's soul hit wildly in the subspace, but every time it hit the space wall, it was impossible to get out.
"What...what is this?!" Blood Demon's voice was filled with real fear for the first time. He has lived for more than ten thousand years and has seen countless magic weapons, but he has never seen anything that can lock space.
Zhang Dehua took a step forward and appeared in front of the subspace. He took out a transparent crystal container from the space ring - it was a specially-made psychic cage specially used to imprison the monk's soul. He pointed the mouth of the container at the subspace and whispered: "Take it."
The subspace, together with the blood demon soul inside, was sucked into the crystal container. The lid of the container closed automatically, and the sealing runes on the surface lit up, locking the Blood Demon Soul firmly inside.
Zhang Dehua raised the container to his eyes and looked at the crazily struggling blood inside.
"Spare your life! Spare your life!" The blood demon's voice came out from the container, full of begging, "I am willing to be a cow or a horse! I am willing to dedicate all my skills! I am willing to be your slave! As long as you spare my life!"
"Do you want to be a bull or a horse?" Zhang Dehua looked at him calmly, "You have been doing evil for thousands of years and how many innocent people have you devoured? When you broke out of the seal just now, the first thing you did was to slaughter the whole world. Are you afraid now?"
"I...I change! I really change! Please, give me a chance!"
"Opportunity?" Zhang Dehua shook his head, "Have you ever given those people who were devoured by you a chance?"
The blood demon was silent.
"Ten thousand years ago, the Tiandao Immortal Lord spent his whole life cultivating to suppress you, and he has already given you a chance. In ten thousand years, you have not repented, but have become more resentful. Such a person does not deserve to live anymore."
Zhang Dehua clenched the container and exerted force with his fingers.
"No-!"
The moment the container shattered, Zhang Dehua's palm released a stream of pure mana, wrapping the blood demon's soul in it. The magic power was like a millstone, crushing the blood demon's soul inch by inch. The bloody light struggled wildly in the palm of his hand and screamed miserably, but to no avail.
After three breaths, the screams stopped.
Blood DemonThe soul turned into dots of red light and disappeared into the dusk. This time, both body and soul were truly destroyed, and there was no chance of reincarnation.
"System." Zhang Dehua said softly.
"Here. It is detected that the host kills the evil cultivator blood demon at the peak of transformation. Evaluation: Killed beyond the level, and the cultivation level is rewarded."
A stream of pure energy surged out of the system and poured into Zhang Dehua's body. The Nascent Soul in Dantian suddenly opened its eyes, greedily absorbing this energy. Yuanying's height increased from seven inches and a half to seven inches and eight minutes, and his aura became more solid.
"The reward calculation is completed. The host's cultivation level has been improved: Nascent Soul Sixth Level, 30% progress."
"Thirty percent?" Zhang Dehua nodded slightly, "Kill a person who is at the peak of his transformation and help me practice for three months. Not bad."
He retracted his hand and turned towards the entrance of the Immortal Mansion. Behind him, in the twilight of the Arctic ice field, the huge crater caused by the missile was still emitting green smoke. It only took half an hour for a generation of evil spirits to go from breaking the seal to falling.
At the entrance to the Immortal Mansion, the members of the expedition team were still waiting. Xuan Shuang looked at the red light dissipating in Zhang Dehua's hand, her eyes full of complexity. Ten thousand years ago, the evil demon that Tiandao Immortal Lord sacrificed himself to suppress was completely eliminated by the young man in front of him in less than an hour.
"Chief, the Blood Demon...is dead?" Professor Zhou Ming asked cautiously.
"Both body and soul will be destroyed." Zhang Dehua said, "Retract the team."
He strode out of the Immortal Mansion and boarded the Lingxiao fighter jet that had been waiting for him for a long time. The engine roared, and the fighter jet soared into the sky and disappeared into the dusk.
The Arctic ice sheet has returned to tranquility. Only the huge crater and the burning smell in the air were left, proving that an unequal battle had taken place here.
Huaxia base, command center.
When Zhang Dehua returned to the base, it was already eight o'clock in the evening. He walked directly into the war conference room without taking a break.
"The matter with the Blood Demon has come to an end." He sat on the main seat and turned on the holographic screen, "But the seal at the bottom of the Immortal Mansion is loose, which means that there is more than one Blood Demon suppressed there. We need to speed up the exploration of the Immortal Mansion and eliminate all of them before more evil things break the seal."
"Yes!" everyone responded in unison.
"In addition." Zhang Dehua looked at the resource management department, "How is the analysis of the spirit stone vein samples in Xianfu?"
"Preliminary analysis has been completed." The Minister of Resources reported, "The purity of the Xianfu Lingshi vein is ten times that of ordinary Lingshi, and the structure is more stable and suitable for artificial synthesis."
"Synthetic?" Zhang Dehua's eyes lit up, "Is it energy-producing?"
"Theoretically yes. We need to build a spirit stone synthesis factory."
